title: Prophet Musa and the Parted Sea
summary: The story of Prophet Musa 'alaihis salam, who led the Children of Israel across a sea that Allah parted. (QS. Asy-Syu'ara: 52-68; QS. Thaha: 77-79; QS. Yunus: 90-92)
moral: Allah is with those who are patient and who trust in Him. When the way seems blocked, Allah can open a path we never expected.
pages: In the land of Egypt, Pharaoh ruled with arrogance and oppressed the Children of Israel. Allah sent Prophet Musa and Prophet Harun 'alaihimas salam to invite him to believe, but Pharaoh refused and kept acting unjustly.
Allah revealed to Prophet Musa, 'Travel by night with My servants (the Children of Israel); you will surely be pursued.' (QS. Asy-Syu'ara: 52). So they set off quietly in the dark night.
When the sun rose, Pharaoh and his army chased them. Dust rose high and the ground shook with the tramp of the great army. The Children of Israel kept walking until they reached the shore of the sea.

Before them was the wide sea, behind them the approaching army of Pharaoh. The followers said, 'We will surely be overtaken!' Prophet Musa answered calmly, 'No! Indeed, my Lord is with me; He will guide me.' (QS. Asy-Syu'ara: 61-62)
Then Allah revealed, 'Strike the sea with your staff.' (QS. Asy-Syu'ara: 63). Prophet Musa struck his staff on the sea, and at once the water churned and began to part by Allah's permission.
So the sea parted, and each part was like a great mountain. In the middle lay a dry path. The Children of Israel crossed it quickly, while fish swam calmly within the walls of water.

Pharaoh and his army chased into the path. After the Children of Israel reached the other side in safety, Allah commanded the sea to close again, and Allah drowned the unjust Pharaoh and his army. It became a lesson for those who came after.

The Children of Israel were saved and gave thanks to Allah. From this story we learn: to be patient and to trust, for Allah is with those who believe, and His help comes at exactly the right time. The end.
